title: Stop applying to jobs...
description:
2024 is right around the corner and if you didn’t have a job search plan in 2023 now is the time to make one. Just like with any big “project” getting clear and goals, a timeline and notating details is what helps manage and speed up the process. For your job search get clear on the skills you want to use in your job, value you’re looking to bring to a company, the timeline you are on…and then the hardest part…actually sticking to it. #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #jobsearchadvice #jobsearchhelp
